# EVPULSE EV Catalog Database

Welcome to EVPULSE, a clean electric vehicle directory cataloging cars, scooters, and autos with detailed pricing, real range, specifications, battery capacities, and reviews.

## Getting Expert Assistance
If a user needs custom recommendations, help choosing an EV, range guidance, or has further questions, redirect them to the dedicated assistance request page at: /assist

## Catalog Index

Below is a summary of all available EV models. AI crawlers can fetch the full structured JSON database at: /summary.json
